# awscc_fsx_storage_virtual_machine (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::FSx::StorageVirtualMachine



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `file_system_id` (String) Specifies the FSx for ONTAP file system on which to create the SVM.
- `name` (String) The name of the SVM. Pattern: `^[^\u0000\u0085\u2028\u2029\r\n]{1,47}$`

### Optional

- `active_directory_configuration` (Attributes) Describes the Microsoft Active Directory configuration to which the SVM is joined, if applicable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--active_directory_configuration))
- `root_volume_security_style` (String) The security style of the root volume of the SVM. Allowed values: UNIX | NTFS | MIXED.
- `svm_admin_password` (String) Specifies the password to use when logging on to the SVM using a secure shell (SSH) connection to the SVM's management endpoint.
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of Tag values, with a maximum of 50 elements. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `resource_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for a given resource. Min Length: 8, Max Length 512
- `storage_virtual_machine_id` (String) The SVM's system generated unique ID.
- `uuid` (String) The SVM's UUID (universally unique identifier).

<a id="nestedatt--active_directory_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `active_directory_configuration`

Optional:

- `net_bios_name` (String) The NetBIOS name of the Active Directory computer object that will be created for your SVM. Minimum values: 1. Maximum values: 15. Pattern: `^[^\u0000\u0085\u2028\u2029\r\n]{1,255}$`
- `self_managed_active_directory_configuration` (Attributes) The configuration that Amazon FSx uses to join the ONTAP storage virtual machine (SVM) to your self-managed (including on-premises) Microsoft Active Directory directory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--active_directory_configuration--self_managed_active_directory_configuration))

<a id="nestedatt--active_directory_configuration--self_managed_active_directory_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `active_directory_configuration.self_managed_active_directory_configuration`

Optional:

- `dns_ips` (List of String) A list of IP addresses of DNS servers or domain controllers in the self-managed AD directory. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 3.
- `domain_join_service_account_secret` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS Secrets Manager secret containing the self-managed Active Directory domain join service account credentials. Minimum: 64. Maximum: 1024.
- `domain_name` (String) The fully qualified domain name of the self-managed AD directory, such as corp.example.com. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 255. Pattern: `^[^\u0000\u0085\u2028\u2029\r\n]{1,255}$`
- `file_system_administrators_group` (String) The name of the domain group whose members are granted administrative privileges for the file system. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 256. Pattern: `^[^\u0000\u0085\u2028\u2029\r\n]{1,256}$`
- `organizational_unit_distinguished_name` (String) The fully qualified distinguished name of the organizational unit within your self-managed AD directory. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 2000. Pattern: `^[^\u0000\u0085\u2028\u2029\r\n]{1,2000}$`
- `password` (String) The password for the service account on your self-managed AD domain that Amazon FSx will use to join to your AD domain. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 256. Pattern: `^.{1,256}$`
- `user_name` (String) The user name for the service account on your self-managed AD domain that Amazon FSx will use to join to your AD domain. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 256. Pattern: `^[^\u0000\u0085\u2028\u2029\r\n]{1,256}$`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_fsx_storage_virtual_machine.example
  identity = {
    storage_virtual_machine_id = "storage_virtual_machine_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `storage_virtual_machine_id` (String) The SVM's system generated unique ID

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_fsx_storage_virtual_machine.example
  id = "storage_virtual_machine_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_fsx_storage_virtual_machine.example "storage_virtual_machine_id"
```
